_comment: macOS unified-log predicate catalogue for the security sidecar (macos-security-log.sh). Each category is an NSPredicate fragment; enabled categories are OR-ed into one `log show --predicate`. Subsystem/category driven on purpose: process-level predicates (loginwindow, tccd) flood the stream with UI chatter. Measure with `./macos-security/macos-security-log.sh --profile 60m` before enabling a noisy one.

authentication.description: Local/remote authentication results: Open Directory auth + account policy evaluation, SSH, screen sharing, screen lock/unlock and login window session events.
authentication.predicate: (subsystem == "com.apple.AccountPolicy") OR (subsystem == "com.apple.opendirectoryd" AND (category == "auth" OR category == "session" OR messageType == "Error")) OR (process == "sshd" OR process == "sshd-session" OR subsystem == "com.apple.sshd") OR (process == "screensharingd") OR (subsystem == "com.apple.loginwindow" AND (eventMessage CONTAINS[c] "login" OR eventMessage CONTAINS[c] "logout" OR eventMessage CONTAINS[c] "lock" OR eventMessage CONTAINS[c] "session"))

authorization.description: Authorization rights granted/denied by authd (admin prompts, privileged helpers) and securityd authorization decisions.

privilege_escalation.description: sudo audit lines ('<user> : TTY=… ; COMMAND=…', failures, sudoers violations). sudo's debug chatter (config reads, group lookups) is excluded.

account_management.description: User/group lifecycle via sysadminctl and dscl (create, delete, password changes, admin group membership).

security_policy.description: Gatekeeper/system policy assessments, XProtect detections and remediation, notarization checks.
security_policy.predicate: (subsystem == "com.apple.syspolicy" AND messageType != "Debug") OR (subsystem == "com.apple.XProtect") OR (process == "XProtectRemediator" OR process == "XProtectBehaviorService")

privacy_tcc.description: Transparency, Consent and Control: privacy permission prompts, denials and overrides (camera, microphone, Full Disk Access, screen recording).
privacy_tcc.predicate: (subsystem == "com.apple.TCC" AND category == "access" AND (eventMessage CONTAINS "Override" OR eventMessage CONTAINS "denied" OR eventMessage CONTAINS "Prompting" OR eventMessage CONTAINS "Denying"))

privacy_tcc_grants.description: Every TCC grant ("Granting TCCDProcess …"). Informative but ~150+ records/hour on a busy desktop. Opt-in.

software_changes.description: Package installs, software updates and installer errors.
software_changes.predicate: (process == "installer") OR (process == "pkgd" AND messageType == "Error") OR (subsystem == "com.apple.softwareupdate" AND (eventMessage CONTAINS[c] "install" OR eventMessage CONTAINS[c] "failed"))

launch_persistence.description: Background items / launch agents & daemons registered or changed (persistence).
launch_persistence.predicate: (subsystem == "com.apple.backgroundtaskmanagement" AND (eventMessage CONTAINS[c] "added" OR eventMessage CONTAINS[c] "removed" OR eventMessage CONTAINS[c] "enabled" OR eventMessage CONTAINS[c] "disabled"))
